evals.prompt: In a new Go project called billing-demo, use modular to initialize a single-process app, add a billing svc with public CreateInvoice and ListInvoices methods, and leave it ready for buf generation.
evals.expected_output: Uses the modular skill, runs or proposes init/service/method commands, creates config/billing + config/billing-demo process aggregation + proto/billing + internal/billing, generates a config.NewRoot entrypoint, and does not hand-edit common generated files.

evals.prompt: We have an existing modular app and need an admin surface for the user svc. Add DisableUser and ListDisabledUsers methods and wire both HTTP and gRPC endpoints into cmd without splitting domain by surface.
evals.expected_output: Uses surface/method flow, keeps domain shared inside internal/user/domain, creates app/admin method files, and rewrites HTTP+gRPC cmd wiring.

evals.prompt: For an order feature, recommend whether the ports belong in app/order/admin adapter or domain/adapter. We need to fetch an order detail, list a customer's orders, save an order aggregate, and cancel an order. Persistence will use Bun.
evals.expected_output: Runs adapter/repository recommendation first, distinguishes app adapter vs domain adapter, proposes QueryRepository and CommandRepository signatures, and waits for confirmation before scaffold.

evals.prompt: Attach Postgres via Bun, Redis, disk storage, and OpenTelemetry to the user svc. Use Application lifecycle resources where the library provides them.
evals.expected_output: Maps Bun/Redis/Telemetry to built-in Resource types, generates only the storage wrapper under internal/user/repository, updates config/user and the single-process aggregate, and keeps cmd on config.NewRoot with server.Transport metadata.

evals.prompt: Run a convention audit on this modular project and tell me if it has old config/config.go, hand-written common files, or cross-svc internal imports.
evals.expected_output: Uses doctor or equivalent read-only checks, reports convention errors and warnings without mutating project files.

evals.prompt: Our single-topology modular app has user and billing services. Make the generated command support a local config file, an etcd remote config, and a CLI override for the user HTTP port.
evals.expected_output: Uses the generated config/<project> aggregate and config.NewRoot, explains --config and --remote, uses a nested --user.http.port override, preserves local-file-over-remote precedence, and does not add a separate command package.

evals.prompt: Migrate this modular project from single-process topology to one process per svc without changing the proto contracts or business packages.
evals.expected_output: Treats topology migration as an agent workflow rather than invoking a nonexistent switch command, rewrites cmd and process config ownership only, and leaves proto/common/internal business code unchanged.

evals.prompt: Our modular user svc needs a localized USER_NOT_FOUND error with a user_id variable. Generate zh-CN and en-US templates, wire the same handler into HTTP and gRPC, and give us the CI check command. Database details must only go to logs.
evals.expected_output: Defines one package-level errs.Message with errs.Define and errs.Template using a named user_id slot, keeps the cause/diagnostic fields out of client data, uses err_template_gen for both locales and --check, initializes logging before one process-level Catalog/Handler, and injects that Handler into both HTTP and gRPC servers.

evals.prompt: Product rewrote our localized MEMBER_NOT_FOUND copy and moved {{.org}} before {{.user_id}}. Update the generated locale set without losing their wording, and explain what happens if a slot is renamed or an old reason remains in YAML.
evals.expected_output: Preserves valid product text and comments because slot order is flexible, runs err_template_gen with the complete language set, rejects renamed/missing/duplicate slots and stale reasons without partial writes, and uses --check for read-only CI validation.
